faqs.question: How do I know this keyboard fits my laptop?
faqs.answer: Each listing shows exact compatible models. If you're unsure of your laptop's exact model, send us a photo of the sticker under your laptop on WhatsApp and we'll confirm.

faqs.question: Do keyboards come backlit?
faqs.answer: Where the original model supports it, we stock both backlit and non-backlit versions — this is stated on the individual product page.

faqs.question: What warranty comes with a keyboard?
faqs.answer: Most keyboards carry a 3-month warranty, listed on the individual product page.
